{White's Nc3 move allows the famous "Fork Trick." How can Black play it?} 4...
Nxe4 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a strong and
temporary sacrifice.] [%hint Sacrifice a knight for a pawn and then use a fork
to win it back.]} (4... Bc5 $5 {This is a reasonable, developing move, but
there's a good capture as well. Try to find it.}) (4... d6 $2 5. Ng5 {Black
has no good defense to White's threats against the f7-pawn. Try again and look
for a more forcing option.}) (4... h6 $2 5. d4 {White has more active pieces
and a slight advantage. Try again and look for a more forcing option.}) (4...
Be7 $2 5. O-O {White has more active pieces and a slight advantage. Try again
and look for a more forcing option.}) 5. Nxe4 {We will examine Bxf7+ in the
next challenge. How should Black win back the sacrificed material after Nxe4?}
d5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good fork.] [%hint
Fork White's bishop and the e4-knight.]} 6. Bxd5 {Good idea! What's next?} Qxd5
{[%wrong White keeps a material advantage. Try again and look for a good
capture.] [%hint Capture a piece.] Well played! Black has good center control
and the better position.} *

{White's Bxf7+ option against the fork trick might look scary, but Black can
reach an excellent position with precise play. How should you escape the check?
} 5... Kxf7 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good
capture.] [%hint Capture the bishop.]} (5... Ke7 $2 {White keeps an extra pawn
and has the safer king as well. Try to find a stronger option.}) 6. Nxe4 {
Good start! How can you take over the center?} d5 {[%wrong There's a better
move. Try to find a good threat.] [%hint Dominate the center with pawns and
make a threat.]} (6... Kg8 $2 7. c4 {White fights for the center with a
roughly even game. Try again and look for a way to dominate the center right
away.}) (6... h6 $2 7. Nxe5+ {White prepares to meet Nxe5 with Qh5+ and Black
has to be extremely careful. Try again and look for a more forcing option.}) (
6... Be7 $2 7. d4 {White has a dangerous attack. Try again and look for a
strong threat.}) (6... Ke8 $2 7. d4 {White has a dangerous attack. Try again
and look for a strong threat.}) 7. Neg5+ {Good move! How should you save your
king?} Kg8 {[%wrong White has a powerful attack against the exposed black king.
Try again and look for a safer move.] [%hint Hide your king on the back rank
behind a pawn.] Great job! Black's exposed king is only a temporary
problem, while the big center and bishop pair are long-term advantages.} (7...
Ke8 $2 8. d4 {Black is only slightly better as the king can get in trouble on
e8. Try to find a safer king move.}) *

{How should Black reach a safe position against the Scotch Four Knights?} 4...
exd4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good capture.] 
[%hint Trade pawns so that you don't need to defend e5.]} (4... Bb4 $5 {
This is playable, but it's stronger to prepare the bishop move by exchanging
pawns. How should you do it?}) (4... d6 $2 5. Bb5 {White pins the black knight
with a slight advantage. Try again and look for a good capture.}) (4... Nxd4 $2
5. Nxd4 {White will recapture with the queen after a trade on d4, maintaining
a lead in development and a good position. Try again and look for a stronger
capture.}) (4... d5 $2 5. Nxe5 {White will emerge from the complications with
an extra pawn. Try again and look for a strong capture.}) 5. Nxd4 {Good start!
How should you continue to develop?} Bb4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try
again and look for a way to make a useful pin.] [%hint Pin the c3-knight.]
Well played! Black threatens Nxe4 and maintains a safe position. We'll look at
White's best continuation in the next challenge.} (5... Nxe4 $2 6. Nxe4 {
Black can win back the sacrificed knight with Qe7, but White can keep the
initiative in a couple of different ways. Try again and look for a safe
developing move.}) (5... Bc5 $2 6. Be3 {White defends the knight and sets up a
discovered attack against the black bishop. Try to find a better bishop move.})
(5... Nxd4 $2 6. Qxd4 {White recaptures with good development and control of
the center. Try again and look for a stronger developing move.}) (5... Qe7 $2
6. Be2 {White prepares to meet Nxe4 with Nd5, which would lead to a powerful
attack. Black is better off developing with another pin. How should you do it?}
) *

{Black has pinned the white knight on c3 and attacked the e4-pawn. How should
White fight back?} 6. Nxc6 {[%wrong Black is doing well. Try again and look
for a good capture.] [%hint Trade knights before defending e4.]} (6. Bg5 $2 h6
{White won't be able to maintain the pin. Try again and look for a more
forcing option.}) (6. f3 $2 d5 {Black fights for the center with a good game.
Try again and look for a more forcing option.}) (6. Bd3 $2 Nxd4 {Black wins a
piece. Try again and look for a good capture.}) 6... bxc6 {Good start! How
should you develop and defend e4?} 7. Bd3 {[%wrong There's a better option.
Try again and look for a good way to defend e4 and develop.] [%hint Develop a
minor piece to defend e4.] Nicely done! White is prepared to castle soon with
an active position.} (7. Qd4 $5 {This is OK, but it's best to develop a minor
piece to defend e4. How should you do it?}) (7. Bg5 $2 Qe7 {Black will soon
play h6 to break the pin on the knight. Try to find a good move with the other
bishop.}) (7. Qf3 $2 Qe7 {It's best to develop a minor piece to defend e4. How
should you do it?}) *

{What familiar trick can White use to take over the center?} 6. Nxe5 {[%wrong

fork trick to eliminate the black center pawn.]} (6. Bxc6 $2 dxc6 {Black has a
safe position. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) (6. d3 $2 Nd4 {
Black is OK. Try again and look for a more forcing option.}) 6... Nxe5 {
Good start! How can you win back the piece with a good position?} 7. d4 {
[%wrong Black keeps a material advantage. Try again and look for a good fork.]
[%hint Fork Black's centralized knight and bishop.]} Bxd4 {Keep it up!} 8. Qxd4
{[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint
Capture an undefended piece.] Well played! White has good center control and
great winning chances.} *

{Black has sacrificed a pawn, but will soon win it back with a good position.
How should you do it?} 6... Bxf2+ {[%wrong There's a stronger option. Try
again and check the hint if you're stuck.] [%hint Sacrifice a piece to decoy
the white king into the open.]} (6... Bd4 $5 {This is a reasonable, way to win
back the sacrificed pawn, but there's an even better bishop move. Try to find
it.}) (6... Qe7 $2 7. d4 {White defends the e5-knight and Black is in trouble.
Try again and look for a stronger attacking option.}) (6... Qd4 $2 7. Nd3 {
White defends f2 and attacks the black bishop. Try again and look for a
stronger attacking option.}) (6... Nxe4 $2 7. Nxe4 {White wins a piece. Try
again and look for a stronger attacking move.}) (6... O-O $2 7. f4 {White
keeps an extra pawn and a good position. Try again and look for a stronger
attacking move.}) 7. Kxf2 {Great move! How should you win back the lost piece?}
Qd4+ {[%wrong There's a better attacking move. Try again and look for a good
check.] [%hint Fork White's king and the e5-knight.]} 8. Kf1 {Great choice!
Keep it up!} Qxe5 {[%wrong White is winning. Try again and look for a good
capture.] [%hint Capture an undefended piece.] Well done! Black has won back
the lost material, with a good game.} *

{White's ahead by a pawn but caught in a dangerous fork. How should you
escape?} 7. Nd3 {[%wrong White's in trouble. Try to find a move to save your
knight and prevent mate on f2.] [%hint Retreat your knight to safely defend f2.
]} (7. O-O $2 Qxe5 {Black wins the knight. Try again and look for a way to
save your knight and stop checkmate.}) (7. Nf3 $2 Qxf2# {That's checkmate. Try
again and look for a better defensive option.}) (7. Ng4 $2 Bxg4 {Black wins
the knight. Try again and look for a way to save your knight and stop
checkmate.}) (7. Nc4 $2 Qxf2# {That's checkmate. Try again and look for a
better defensive option.}) 7... Nxe4 {Good move! How can you win material?} 8.
Qe2 {[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try again and look for a way to win
material.] [%hint Pin the e4-knight.] Great choice! White will soon win the
pinned knight and should win the game as well.} (8. Nxe4 $2 Qxe4+ {Black wins
back the piece with a good position. Try to find a stronger option.}) *
